vol_tiled_map — 3D domain op

• データ種: voxel → voxel

• 呼び出し: import volops; volops.vol_tiled_map(vol, fn, tile=64, overlap=8) (または ops3d.get("vol_tiled_map"))

使い方

Apply a shape-preserving volume operator in overlapping z-slabs, so peak
